title: My dogs hate it
text: My dogs don’t seem to like the taste of bark box treats. This is the third box I’ve purchased and it’s always the same case. The treats smell weird, so maybe that’s why they refuse to eat them. In addition, the toys gave one of my dogs a lot of acne so we had to take them away. The toys have an artificial vanilla scent to them so perhaps that’s the cause. Not sure. I just know that I had to donate the entire box to someone else because my dogs couldn’t use anything in it.
label: negative
